title: Compressed Air Leak Detection

engineFeatures.meaning: the entity, amount and date every output must contain

label: For "Compressed Air Leak Detection": Detect compressed air leaks from flow, pressure and compressor data and prioritise repairs by energy cost so waste falls. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Total flow monitoring only.
